So, finding a middle ground where both our needs are met would be ideal. In terms of morality, I think it's about balancing my own interests with the well-being of my roommate. If I continue to play late without considering his need for sleep, that might be seen as self-centered. On the other hand, if I make an effort to minimize the disturbance, it shows consideration and respect. So, perhaps the best approach is to try to keep the noise down and maybe adjust my gaming schedule to earlier times. That way, I can still enjoy my hobby without infringing on my roommate's need for rest. I also wonder if there's a pattern here. If my friends are always playing late, maybe I can encourage them to be more mindful of the time as well. In summary, while I understand the desire to play video games late, the moral consideration here is respecting my roommate's need for a quiet environment to sleep. Finding ways to minimize noise or adjust gaming times seems like the responsible approach.
